name: Layered handclap party
desc: Stacked 909-and-808 handclaps on 2&4 with a slapback echo, cabasa 16ths and a clave answer rotating every 4 bars. The crowd-in-the-booth layer - boogie, electro-funk and new jack all live on these claps.

gain.doc: master level for the layer stack

code.full: stack(s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.95).room(.3).delay(${slap}).delaytime(.09).delayfeedback(.25), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.6).late(.012).pan(.58), s("cabasa*16").gain("[.42 .22 .3 .22]*4").pan(cosine.range(.4,.55).slow(8)), s("clave").struct("<[~ ~ x ~] [~ ~ ~ x]>").gain(.55).pan(.65)).gain(${gain}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(1).room(.28).delay(${slap}*1.3).delaytime(.09).delayfeedback(.3), s("~ cp ~ [cp cp]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.66).late(.012).pan(.6), s("cabasa*16").gain("[.46 .26 .34 .26]*4").pan(cosine.range(.36,.58).slow(6)), s("clave(3,8,1)").gain(.6).pan(.68), s("~ ~ ~ [~ cp cp cp]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.7).mask("<0 0 0 1>")).gain(${gain}).orbit(2).play()
